genres.name: Fantasy
genres.description: Stories set in magical or imaginary worlds where supernatural forces, mythical beings, or epic quests drive the narrative.

subgenres.name: High Fantasy
subgenres.description: Epic tales in fully imagined worlds with sprawling quests, kingdoms, and battles of good vs. evil.

subgenres.name: Low Fantasy
subgenres.description: Stories where magical or supernatural elements intrude upon an otherwise realistic setting.

subgenres.name: Urban Fantasy
subgenres.description: Modern-day settings where magic and supernatural creatures coexist with everyday life.

subgenres.name: Dark Fantasy
subgenres.description: A blend of fantasy and horror, focusing on grim atmospheres, twisted creatures, and moral ambiguity.

subgenres.name: Mythic Fantasy
subgenres.description: Tales inspired by mythology, folklore, or gods, often reimagining ancient legends.

genres.name: Science Fiction
genres.description: Stories exploring the impact of science, technology, and the future on societies and individuals.

subgenres.name: Hard Sci-Fi
subgenres.description: Focus on scientific accuracy and realistic depictions of technology and physics.

subgenres.name: Soft Sci-Fi
subgenres.description: Explores social, psychological, or political themes with light scientific detail.

subgenres.name: Cyberpunk
subgenres.description: Dystopian futures dominated by high technology, corporations, and hackers.

subgenres.name: Space Opera
subgenres.description: Grand interstellar adventures with empires, space battles, and sweeping drama.

subgenres.name: Post-Apocalyptic Sci-Fi
subgenres.description: Stories about survival after civilization collapses due to scientific or technological causes.

genres.name: Historical Fiction
genres.description: Stories set in real historical periods, often blending fact with fiction to explore past societies.

subgenres.name: War Stories
subgenres.description: Dramas set during real historical conflicts, highlighting personal and social struggles.

subgenres.name: Period Romance
subgenres.description: Love stories set against the backdrop of historical eras.

subgenres.name: Biographical Fiction
subgenres.description: Fictional retellings of real people's lives, blending fact and imagination.

subgenres.name: Alternate History
subgenres.description: Explores what might have happened if historical events had gone differently.

subgenres.name: Cultural Fiction
subgenres.description: Focuses on everyday life, traditions, and social customs of past societies.

genres.name: Romance
genres.description: Stories centered on love, relationships, and emotional connection.

subgenres.name: Contemporary Romance
subgenres.description: Love stories set in modern times with relatable characters and challenges.

subgenres.name: Historical Romance
subgenres.description: Romantic stories set in past eras, influenced by period culture and customs.

subgenres.name: Fantasy Romance
subgenres.description: Love stories that blend romance with magic, mythical beings, or fantastical worlds.

subgenres.name: Romantic Suspense
subgenres.description: Romances intertwined with danger, mystery, or thrilling plots.

subgenres.name: Comedy Romance
subgenres.description: Lighthearted love stories filled with humor, misunderstandings, and fun.

genres.name: Mystery / Thriller
genres.description: Stories that focus on suspense, secrets, crime, and unraveling puzzles.

subgenres.name: Detective Fiction
subgenres.description: Investigators following clues to solve crimes.

subgenres.name: Psychological Thriller
subgenres.description: Suspense driven by mind games, unreliable narrators, and psychological tension.

subgenres.name: Noir
subgenres.description: Dark, morally gray tales featuring antiheroes navigating corruption.

subgenres.name: Cozy Mystery
subgenres.description: Light-hearted whodunits set in close-knit communities with amateur sleuths.

subgenres.name: Legal Thriller
subgenres.description: Courtroom battles and legal intrigue where justice hangs in the balance.

subgenres.name: Police Procedural
subgenres.description: Crime-solving through official investigative work and procedure.

genres.name: Horror
genres.description: Stories that evoke fear, dread, and the supernatural to unsettle the audience.

subgenres.name: Gothic Horror
subgenres.description: Haunted castles, ancestral secrets, and dark atmospheres.

subgenres.name: Psychological Horror
subgenres.description: Madness, paranoia, and inner fears explored through characters' minds.

subgenres.name: Supernatural Horror
subgenres.description: Ghosts, demons, curses, and entities beyond the natural world.

subgenres.name: Body Horror
subgenres.description: Grotesque transformations and the fragility of the human body.

subgenres.name: Survival Horror
subgenres.description: Characters trapped in dangerous situations, struggling to stay alive.

genres.name: Adventure
genres.description: Exciting journeys, quests, and explorations often featuring heroes overcoming great obstacles.

subgenres.name: Quest Adventure
subgenres.description: Heroic journeys with clear goals and trials.

subgenres.name: Survival Adventure
subgenres.description: Struggles in the wilderness or against nature.

subgenres.name: Swashbuckling
subgenres.description: Pirates, treasure hunts, sword fights, and daring feats.

subgenres.name: Exploration
subgenres.description: Uncharted lands, ancient ruins, or lost civilizations.

subgenres.name: Hero's Journey
subgenres.description: Classic structure of growth through trials and personal transformation.

genres.name: Comedy / Satire
genres.description: Stories designed to amuse, entertain, and often critique society through humor.

subgenres.name: Romantic Comedy
subgenres.description: Humorous love stories full of charm and misunderstandings.

subgenres.name: Satire / Parody
subgenres.description: Witty takes that mock or exaggerate social norms and tropes.

subgenres.name: Slapstick Comedy
subgenres.description: Physical humor, exaggerated antics, and mischief.

subgenres.name: Dark Comedy
subgenres.description: Finding humor in grim or tragic events.

subgenres.name: Situational Comedy
subgenres.description: Comedy arising from everyday misunderstandings and interactions.

genres.name: Drama
genres.description: Emotion-driven stories focusing on realistic characters and conflicts.

subgenres.name: Family Drama
subgenres.description: Explores interpersonal conflicts within families.

subgenres.name: Tragedy
subgenres.description: Depicts downfall or suffering of characters due to flaws or fate.

subgenres.name: Social Drama
subgenres.description: Addresses social, class, or political issues.

subgenres.name: Crime Drama
subgenres.description: Focuses on justice, law enforcement, or organized crime.

subgenres.name: Melodrama
subgenres.description: Exaggerated emotions and sensational conflicts.

genres.name: Dystopian / Post-Apocalyptic
genres.description: Stories set in broken, oppressive, or collapsed societies exploring human resilience.

subgenres.name: Classic Dystopia
subgenres.description: Totalitarian regimes, oppression, and rebellion.

subgenres.name: Post-Nuclear Apocalypse
subgenres.description: Wastelands and survival after nuclear disaster.

subgenres.name: Eco-Collapse
subgenres.description: Nature destroyed, humanity struggling to survive.

subgenres.name: Tech Dystopia
subgenres.description: AI control, mass surveillance, or cyber oppression.

subgenres.name: Plague Apocalypse
subgenres.description: Global pandemics wiping out civilization.

genres.name: Superhero
genres.description: Stories of extraordinary individuals with powers or abilities, often fighting for justice or survival.

subgenres.name: Classic Superhero
subgenres.description: Heroic tales of good vs. evil with powerful protagonists.

subgenres.name: Anti-Hero
subgenres.description: Morally complex heroes who bend or break the rules.

subgenres.name: Superhero Team
subgenres.description: Groups of heroes uniting to face threats.

subgenres.name: Villain-Focused
subgenres.description: Stories told from the perspective of villains.

subgenres.name: Realistic Superhero
subgenres.description: Explores what superpowers would mean in a grounded, real-world setting.

genres.name: Slice of Life
genres.description: Stories that capture everyday experiences and realistic portrayals of life.

subgenres.name: Coming of Age
subgenres.description: Youthful characters growing and learning about life.

subgenres.name: Workplace Drama
subgenres.description: Focuses on challenges and relationships at work.

subgenres.name: School Life
subgenres.description: Stories set in schools, exploring friendships and rivalries.

subgenres.name: Family Life
subgenres.description: Everyday joys and struggles of family dynamics.

subgenres.name: Romance Slice of Life
subgenres.description: Gentle, realistic portrayals of love in daily life.
